verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent SDK lets teams write and version agent logic as code within normal dev workflows, and one blog post mentions publishing agents 'via CI/CD,' suggesting some automation-friendly deployment path. However, there is no documented CLI, headless execution mode, or API-driven automation harness for running/testing the platform in CI beyond this single CI/CD publish mention. missing for 10: dedicated CLI/headless runtime, CI test-harness docs, independent confirmation of CI/CD usage.
